quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Fish!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It has a tall line with a small crossbar, like a tiny flagpole.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found f. It comes right after E.
quests.funFact: Some fish, like sharks, don't have a single bone in their body—only cartilage!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Giraffe!
quests.question: g
quests.hint: It comes right after F.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found g. It comes right before H.
quests.funFact: Giraffes have the exact same number of neck bones as humans!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Hat!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a curved leg beside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found h. It comes right after G.
quests.funFact: The tallest hat in the world was over 15 feet tall!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Ice Cream!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found I. It comes right after H.
quests.funFact: It takes about 50 licks to finish a single scoop of ice cream!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Juice!
quests.question: J
quests.hint: It comes right after I.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found J. It comes right before K.
quests.funFact: It takes about 3 to 4 medium oranges to make one glass of fresh orange juice!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Kite!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two legs kicking out to the side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found K. It comes right after J.
quests.funFact: Kites were invented in China over 2,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Lion!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found l. It comes right after K.
quests.funFact: A lion's roar is so loud it can be heard from 5 miles away!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Monkey!
quests.question: m
quests.hint: It comes right after L.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found m. It comes right before N.
quests.funFact: Spider monkeys have strong tails that they use like an extra arm!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Ninja!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: It has one little hump, like a small hill.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found n. It comes right after M.
quests.funFact: Ninjas wore dark blue clothes at night, not black, to blend in better with the sky!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Owl!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: It has a big round circle.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found O. It comes right after N.
quests.funFact: Owls can't move their eyeballs, so they have to turn their entire heads to look around!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Penguin!
quests.question: P
quests.hint: It comes right after O.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found P. It comes right before Q.
quests.funFact: Penguins don't have teeth; they have fleshy spines inside their mouths to swallow fish!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Quilt!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: It has a big circle with a small tail crossing the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found Q. It comes right after P.
quests.funFact: The oldest known quilt is over 2,000 years old!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Robot!
quests.question: r
quests.hint: It has a short straight line with a small curve at the top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found r. It comes right after Q.
quests.funFact: The word 'robot' comes from a Czech word meaning forced labor!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Shark!
quests.question: s
quests.hint: It comes right after R.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found s. It comes right before T.
quests.funFact: Sharks have been on Earth longer than trees have!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Tiger!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a small crossbar near the top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found t. It comes right after S.
quests.funFact: A tiger's stripes are like fingerprints; no two tigers have the exact same pattern!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Unicorn!
quests.question: U
quests.hint: It has a curved dip with two straight sides, like a little cup.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found U. It comes right after T.
quests.funFact: The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Volcano!
quests.question: V
quests.hint: It comes right after U.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found V. It comes right before W.
quests.funFact: There are volcanoes on other planets, and the biggest one is on Mars!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Whale!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: It has four slanted lines dipping up and down, like two V's together.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found W. It comes right after V.
quests.funFact: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for X-ray!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: It has two short lines crossing in the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found x. It comes right after W.
quests.funFact: X-rays were discovered completely by accident in 1895!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Yak!
quests.question: y
quests.hint: It comes right after X.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found y. It comes right before Z.
quests.funFact: Yaks have larger lungs and hearts than most cattle to help them live in high mountains!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Zoo!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: It has a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found z. It comes right after Y.
quests.funFact: The oldest zoo in the world still operating today is in Vienna, built in 1752!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Astronaut!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: It has two slanted lines meeting at the top, with a short line across the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found A. It comes right before B.
quests.funFact: Astronauts can grow up to two inches taller while living in space!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Bear!
quests.question: B
quests.hint: It comes right after A.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found B. It comes right before C.
quests.funFact: Bears have an incredible sense of smell, much better than a dog's!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Car!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: It has a big curved line, open on the right, like a large moon.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found C. It comes right after B.
quests.funFact: The first cars didn't have steering wheels; drivers used a lever!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Dinosaur!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: It comes right after C.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found d. It comes right before E.
quests.funFact: Some dinosaurs were as small as a chicken!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Earth!
quests.question: e
quests.hint: It comes right before F.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! e has a small circle with a flat line across the middle.
quests.funFact: Earth is the only planet in our solar system not named after a god!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Frog!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It comes right after E.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found f. It comes right before G.
quests.funFact: Frogs drink water by absorbing it directly through their skin!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Guitar!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: It comes right after F.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found G. It comes right before H.
quests.funFact: The world's smallest guitar is no bigger than a single human blood cell!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Horse!
quests.question: H
quests.hint: It comes right before I.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! H has two tall straight lines joined by a bridge in the middle.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Igloo!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It comes right after H.
quests.explanation: Well done! You found I. It comes right before J.
quests.funFact: An igloo can be 40 degrees warmer inside than outside, just from body heat!
